purpose: P2-G2 element declaration (handoff §5/§7): audit corpus elements before training; the generative kernel is CNOF-only, so v1 trains on the CNOF-clean subset.

v1_scope.kernel: CNOF (C/N/O/F) generative heads; the seed is pure carbon and atoms enter only by CNOF insertion
v1_scope.trainable_now: the CNOF-clean subset (~92.5% of R1) -> exported to generator_corpus_cnof_v1.smiles (429,335 unique, <=96 heavy, neutral, incl. R0 anchor)
v1_scope.covers: amine heads + ester/amide/carbamate/urea/ether/aza-Michael/Ugi/Passerini/reductive-amination/epoxide/acetal linkers; ALL BEAE-class chemistry (amine + acrylate + propiolate enamine-ester = C/N/O)

deferred_to_v2.scope: S (thioether/disulfide, 4.0%) + P (iPhos phosphate, 3.6%) = ~7.6% of reachable support -- the degradable-linker/phospholipid families
deferred_to_v2.requires: widen CNOF_ATOM_TYPES (factorized_fiber.py:51) + generative heads + valence/H masks + empirical prior regen + the two hard gates (_in_scope in data/cnof.py, _assert_supported_state in factorized_fiber.py); SHARED RGM core -> coordinate with Codex (pairs with the ~48-atom kernel bump)
